en.headline: Woman jailed 63 months for illegal pharmaceutical exports and money laundering
en.dek: Customs seized about 1.6 million controlled tablets worth an estimated HK$55 million in 2021. The District Court also ordered confiscation of roughly HK$470,000 in frozen assets.
body: A local woman was sentenced to 63 months’ imprisonment by the District Court yesterday for illegal export and possession of controlled pharmaceutical products and money laundering, Customs said. The offences involved the Import and Export Ordinance, Trade Descriptions Ordinance, Pharmacy and Poisons Ordinance and Organised and Serious Crimes Ordinance.

Between September and October 2021, officers seized approximately 1.6 million tablets of controlled pharmaceutical products, some counterfeit, with an estimated market value of about HK$55 million at the airport, an industrial unit in Hung Hom and a logistics centre in Sheung Wan. Investigation found the woman had recruited others to pack and post the goods and rented industrial premises for the operation.

She received unidentified bank transfers and cash through personal accounts, handling crime proceeds of about HK$15 million, and withdrew funds to pay wages and postage. Customs welcomed the custodial sentence as a deterrent reflecting the seriousness of the offences. Prosecutors applied for a confiscation order over about HK$470,000 in frozen assets.

zh.headline: 女子非法出口受管制藥劑及洗黑錢判監63個月
zh.dek: 海關2021年檢獲約160萬粒受管制藥劑製品，市值約5500萬元。區域法院另就約47萬元凍結資產作出充公申請。
body: 一名本地女子因非法出口及管有受管制藥劑製品，以及洗黑錢，違反《進出口條例》、《商品說明條例》、《藥劑業及毒藥條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，昨日於區域法院被判監禁共63個月。
海關在2021年9月至10月期間，分別於機場、紅磡工業大廈單位及上環物流服務中心，檢獲共約160萬粒受管制藥劑製品，當中部分為仿製藥品，市值約5500萬元。調查發現該女子招攬他人安排包裝及郵寄，並租用工業大廈單位作為營運基地。
她透過個人銀行戶口收取來歷不明轉帳及現金，處理犯罪得益高達約1500萬元，並提取資金支付薪金及郵費。海關對判刑表示歡迎，指具阻嚇作用，反映罪行嚴重性。控方已申請充公該女子約47萬元凍結資產。
